name: medium-research-rss
description: Generic RSS 2.0 / Atom 1.0 feed research with normalized MCP output. A single rss_fetch(url, limit?) tool ingests ANY feed URL and maps each entry onto the shared item contract with type "article" and BOTH score and num_comments null (RSS carries no engagement metric). Deliberately ships ONE tool (no *_get / *_search): feed items already carry their content and the feed URL is the query. Two documented recipes: (1) read-only subreddit — rss_fetch("https://www.reddit.com/r/<sub>/.rss"); (2) YouTube channel/playlist — rss_fetch("https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<UC…>") or "?playlist_id=<PL…>", surfacing each video's watch link (url), channel (author), and description (text). YouTube feeds are per-channel/playlist only — no keyword search (retired; the paid Data API is out of scope). Fetches only through the shared SSRF-guarded getText path (scheme allowlist + private-range denylist + per-redirect re-validation); the optional RSS_ALLOWED_HOSTS operator allowlist locks fetching to listed hosts. Runs keyless — no credentials. Actual .mcpb packing is deferred to v2 (PKG-01); this manifest is documentation/scaffold only.
